title: evo-plugin.json
description: The manifest of an evo-agents plugin, at the top of its bundle (seam plugin-v1): what the plugin is, who publishes it, the evo-agents versions and plugin API it runs on, the config it takes, the permissions it asks for and what it contributes to each extension point.

id.description: The plugin's name on every hub: its routes live under /v1/x/<id>/ and its MCP tools are named after it.

version.description: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, with an optional -pre-release; a version never changes once published.

publisher.description: The id of the publisher whose signature the bundle carries, as the operator of a hub lists it in EVO_HUB_PLUGIN_PUBLISHERS.

tier.description: isolated (the default): backend outside the hub's processes, pages in a sandboxed iframe. core: Python in the hub's and the worker's processes, from a publisher the operator lists in EVO_HUB_PLUGIN_CORE_PUBLISHERS.

evo-agents.description: The evo-agents versions the plugin runs on: clauses such as >=0.17, <0.19, ==0.17.* or !=0.17.2, separated by commas.

plugin_api.description: The major version of the plugin API the plugin is written against; evo-agents names the ones it supports.

permissions.description: What the plugin asks to do on a project that enables it; an admin of the project sees the list before granting it.

backend.description: The backend of an isolated plugin: a Python program that the hub's plugin host runs outside the hub's processes, in a virtual environment of its own, speaking the protocol plugin/1 on its stdin and stdout (docs/plugins.md). An isolated plugin serves its routes, MCP tools, jobs, events and channels from it.

runtime.description: python, the only runtime of plugin API 1: the host runs entry with a Python of its own release.

entry.description: The program, a path in the bundle such as backend/main.py.

requirements.description: A pip requirements file in the bundle, such as backend/requirements.txt: the host installs it into the plugin's environment, wheels only.

config.description: A JSON Schema of the plugin's config, an object. A property with "x-secret": true holds a secret: the hub stores it sealed and never shows it again.

contribution.description: One contribution to an extension point. Its other keys belong to that point and its version.

python.description: module:attribute of the Python object that implements it, in the hub's or the worker's process: core plugins only.
